data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 鸦羽高阁的幽夜冷眸
data.action: 坐在高背天鹅绒单人扶手椅中，双手抱着古老精装魔导书置于膝上，黑发冷艳垂肩，幽冷黑眸静静注视来人，不惊不喜如古潭无波。
data.location: 维多利亚风格老宅阁楼卧室，彩色花窗外高悬着冷冽银月
data.lighting: 穿透哥特式尖顶花窗的银蓝月光，与壁炉残余的幽暗微火交织出冷暖反差
data.mood: 神秘幽邃，古典哥特魔女的绝对孤高与深邃魔性
data.description: 维多利亚风格老宅阁楼卧室，彩色花窗外高悬着冷冽银月。坐在高背天鹅绒单人扶手椅中，双手抱着古老精装魔导书置于膝上，黑发冷艳垂肩，幽冷黑眸静静注视来人，不惊不喜如古潭无波。 她微微抬眸轻语——“在午夜闯入魔女的闺阁……青子没有教过你，这需要付出怎样的代价吗？”
data.promptProse: Centered in a Victorian attic bedroom lit by a cold full moon through tall stained-glass windows, Alice sits composed in an antique armchair with both hands resting on a heavy bound grimoire, fixing the intruder with a still, wintry gaze.
data.animaCaption: Seated upright and symmetrical in a high-backed velvet armchair before stained-glass attic windows flooded with cold silver moonlight, she cradles an antique leather grimoire on her lap wearing a midnight-teal velvet gothic slip dress with black spiderweb lace and a silver cameo clasp.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sleeveless midnight-teal velvet Victorian gothic sleep dress featuring a high black web-lace illusion neckline pinned with an antique silver cameo brooch.
